title: Mediocrity is the key for LLM as a Judge Anchor Selection
authors_zh: Shachar Don-Yehiya, Asaf Yehudai, Leshem Choshen, Omri Abend
paper_type_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge 锚点选择分析与大规模比较判决数据
best_for_zh: 需要设计、校准或审计成对比较式 LLM Judge 与模型排行榜的研究者。
one_line: This work shows that middling anchors make pairwise LLM judging more informative than extreme anchors.
该研究表明，在 LLM Judge 的锚点式比较中，中等能力锚点比极强或极弱锚点更能区分模型排序。
why: It makes the hidden choice of comparison anchor measurable and auditable in scalable model evaluation.
inclusion_reason: The release exposes large-scale judge verdicts and confidence signals for auditing anchor selection in pairwise LLM evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
To avoid the quadratic cost of all-pairs comparisons, evaluations such as Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval compare every candidate with one fixed anchor. When the anchor is too strong or too weak, most outcomes become one-sided and reveal little about similarly capable models; ranking changes may be attributed to the judge when the real cause is reference selection.

The paper systematically varies anchors and judges on the same response set, measures agreement with human rankings, and releases large-scale judgment records for studying anchor informativeness, confidence, and required sample size.

为降低模型两两比较的二次成本，Arena-Hard 和 AlpacaEval 等评测常让所有候选与一个固定 anchor 比较。但 anchor 过强或过弱时，绝大多数结果会变成单边胜负，难以区分实力接近的模型；排行榜变化可能被误归因于 Judge，而真正原因是参照物选择。

论文系统改变 anchor 和 Judge，在同一回答集上测量与人类排名的一致性，并发布大规模判断记录，用于分析 anchor 信息量、置信度和所需样本量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The study tests 22 different anchors on Arena-Hard-v2.0 and constructs roughly nine hundred thousand pairwise judgments containing candidate and anchor responses plus verdict and confidence information from five judges. The key finding is that medium-performing anchors are most informative: the strongest and weakest models almost always win or lose and therefore reveal little about relative rankings. The data support judge calibration, anchor selection, power analysis, and ranking-robustness research; the object is evaluation design rather than a new generator.

论文在 Arena-Hard-v2.0 上测试 22 个不同 anchor，并构造约 90 万级回答对判断数据；记录包含候选回答、anchor 回答、五个 Judge 的 verdict 与置信信息。核心发现是中等水平 anchor 最具区分力：最佳或最差模型因几乎总胜或总负，反而无法提供相对排序信息。数据可用于 Judge 校准、anchor 选择、统计功效分析和排名鲁棒性研究，其对象是评价设计本身而非新的生成模型。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the response pool: Arena-Hard-v2.0 prompts and multi-model responses are reused while keeping the set of ranked models fixed.
  1. Rotate anchors: Twenty-two anchors spanning ability levels are selected, and each candidate response is compared with the corresponding anchor response.
  1. Collect multi-judge labels: Five judges output winners, ties, and confidence information, producing roughly nine hundred thousand judgment records that are aligned with human model rankings.
  1. Analyse informativeness: The study computes ranking correlation, win-rate distributions, and statistical power for each anchor and estimates the sample size needed to distinguish models. Reproduction requires fixed response versions, judge prompts, and pair order.

1. 建立候选回答池： 复用 Arena-Hard-v2.0 的提示和多模型回答，保持待排名模型集合不变。
  1. 轮换 anchor： 从不同能力层级选择 22 个 anchor，让每个候选回答分别与 anchor 回答成对比较。
  1. 多 Judge 标注： 调用五个 Judge 输出胜负、平局和置信信息，形成约 90 万级判断记录，并与人类模型排名对齐。
  1. 分析信息量： 计算不同 anchor 下的排名相关、胜率分布和统计功效，推导可靠区分模型所需题量。复现需固定回答版本、Judge 提示和配对顺序。

title: Evidence
证据
html: With the same Arena-Hard-v2.0 prompts and candidate models, changes caused by anchor selection are comparable in magnitude to changes caused by switching judges. Comparisons against the strongest and weakest anchors are highly saturated, while medium anchors align better with human rankings. Power analysis also shows that common benchmark sizes are insufficient for reliably distinguishing close models. Because only the anchor is controlled, the evidence supports the attribution, although it mainly covers single-anchor pairwise evaluation and this model pool.

在同一 Arena-Hard-v2.0 数据和候选模型下，anchor 选择造成的排名相关变化与更换 Judge 的影响量级相当。最强和最弱 anchor 的比较结果高度饱和，而中等 anchor 与人类排行榜的一致性更高。功效分析进一步显示常见 benchmark 题量不足以稳定区分相近模型。证据来自受控替换 anchor，因此能支持因果归因，但结论主要针对单 anchor、成对比较和该模型池。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Previous judge research focuses on position bias, self-preference, or judge-model choice and treats the anchor as an implementation detail. This work makes anchor identity an independent experimental variable and quantifies its effect using multiple judges, large-scale pairs, and power analysis. The novelty is not a new ranking algorithm but evidence that choosing a medium reference is as consequential as choosing the judge.
既有 Judge 研究重点检查位置偏差、自我偏好或 Judge 模型差异，通常把 anchor 当成固定实现细节。本文首次把 anchor 作为独立实验变量，并用多 Judge、大规模配对和功效分析量化其影响。新意不是提出新的排序算法，而是证明“选择中等参照物”是与选择 Judge 同等重要的评价决策。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Benchmark dependence: The optimal anchor position may depend on Arena-Hard prompts, model pool, and human ranking. Code, medical, or multimodal evaluation requires re-estimation.
  1. Human-ranking noise: An aggregate human leaderboard is not uncontested item-level truth. Confidence intervals and preference subgroups should accompany one correlation coefficient.
  1. Remaining cost: Auditing many anchors with five judges is expensive. Practical deployments can first run small-scale power analysis instead of reproducing every judgment.

1. 基准依赖： Arena-Hard 的提示、模型池和人类排名可能影响最佳 anchor 位置；迁移到代码、医疗或多模态任务需重新估计。
  1. 人类排名噪声： 总体人类排行榜并非逐题无争议真值；应报告置信区间和不同人群偏好，而非只优化一个相关系数。
  1. 成本仍高： 多 anchor 与五 Judge 的审计规模很大；实际部署可先做小规模功效分析，而非直接复制全部判断。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Choose evaluation anchors: Pilot anchors at several ability levels and select a medium model whose win rates are not saturated and whose ranking agrees with human evaluation.
  1. Calibrate judges: Use the released judgments to study position, confidence, and judge variation while reporting anchor and judge effects separately.
  1. Plan benchmark size: Use power analysis to estimate the comparisons needed to distinguish target models rather than drawing leaderboard conclusions from small win-rate gaps.

1. 选择评价 anchor： 在新 benchmark 上先采样多个能力层级的 anchor，选择胜率不过度饱和且与人工排序一致的中等模型。
  1. Judge 校准： 利用公开判断记录研究位置、置信度和 Judge 差异，并将 anchor 效应与 Judge 效应分开报告。
  1. 题量规划： 使用功效分析决定需要多少比较才能区分目标模型，避免从小样本胜率差异得出排行榜结论。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: The paper shows that an LLM-judge anchor is not neutral and that medium models are usually more reliable than extreme anchors.
  1. Method takeaway: Fix prompts and candidates, rotate 22 anchors and five judges, and compare resulting rankings with humans and statistical power.
  1. Data takeaway: Roughly nine hundred thousand pairwise judgments preserve candidates, anchors, judge verdicts, and confidence information.
  1. Evidence anchor: Anchor effects rival judge choice, extreme anchors saturate outcomes, and common benchmark sizes lack power for close models.
  1. Reuse decision: Best for leaderboard design and judge calibration; rerun anchor pilots and power analysis in every new domain.

1. 一句话定位： 该论文证明 LLM Judge 排名中的 anchor 不是中性参照，中等模型通常比最强或最弱模型更可靠。
  1. 方法抓手： 固定提示与候选，轮换 22 个 anchor、五个 Judge，再与人类排名和统计功效对照。
  1. 数据抓手： 约 90 万级成对判断保存候选、anchor、Judge verdict 和置信信息。
  1. 证据锚点： anchor 影响与更换 Judge 同量级，极端 anchor 结果饱和，常用题量不足以区分近邻模型。
  1. 复用决定： 适合排行榜设计与 Judge 校准；新领域必须重新做 anchor 试验和功效分析。
